rca of the issue: POST /api/sandbox/contexts/{cid}/sample-doc/accept was 500ing. RCA: sandbox_sample_doc_accept called write_audit() with kwargs that do not match the core.write_audit signature (`actor_account_id=`, `context_id=` at end) AND omitted `await` on an async function. FastAPI surfaced this as a plain 500 (TypeError: write_audit() got an unexpected keyword argument 'actor_account_id' — confirmed in backend.err.log). Fix: replaced with `await write_audit(context_id, current['id'], 'sandbox.sample_doc.accept', 'document', doc_id, {'title': body.title})`. Repro: create a fresh sandbox, GET the sample-doc, POST /accept with the payload → 500 before fix, 200 {ok:true, doc_id, title} after. Subsequent GET returns {already_accepted:true} and the document appears in /api/contexts/{cid}/documents.
